title: [LOGGED IN] Buying a Loyalty Shop item without enough points shows a "not enough points" message
reason: Not enough loyalty points toast shown; balance stayed 40; Available 1/1 unchanged

steps.text: Open store URL with user-id and wait until loaded
steps.saw: Store page loaded with cookie banner

steps.text: If cookie banner shown click Dismiss; if Login successful popup click Ok
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss; no Login successful popup

steps.text: Does the header show the green Player{TEST_USER_ID} button, and no Login button?
steps.saw: Green Player{TEST_USER_ID} button, balances 40 and 0, no Login button

steps.text: Click Loyalty shop in the header
steps.saw: Loyalty shop section opened, nav item highlighted

steps.text: Is the teal loyalty points balance in the header lower than 300? (precondition)
Does the Unique Avatar card show Available: 1/1 and a green 300 button?
steps.saw: Unique Avatar card shows 'Available: 1/1' and green 300 button

steps.text: Click the green 300 button on the Unique Avatar card
Is a message shown that there are not enough points (and no Redeem or go to checkout window)?
steps.saw: Toast 'Not enough loyalty points. Earn more by making purchases.'; no Redeem/checkout window

steps.text: Close any popup or cart that opened with its close (x) button
Is the teal loyalty points balance in the header the same as before the click?
Does the Unique Avatar card still show Available: 1/1?
